mapper.select:
SELECT wo.id, wo.work_order_no, wo.production_order_id, wo.work_type, wo.status, wo.handler_id, wo.handler_name, wo.cost, wo.estimated_hours, wo.actual_hours, wo.start_time, wo.complete_time, wo.complete_images, wo.logistics_no, wo.remark, wo.quality_notes, wo.create_time, wo.update_time,
m.name AS material_name, m.img_name AS material_img_url, m.standard AS material_standard, m.model AS material_model, m.color AS material_color,
u.username AS user_username, p.name AS user_real_name FROM jsh_work_order wo
LEFT JOIN jsh_production_order po ON wo.production_order_id = po.id AND IFNULL(po.delete_flag, '0') != '1'
LEFT JOIN jsh_material m ON po.material_id = m.id AND IFNULL(m.delete_flag, '0') != '1'
LEFT JOIN jsh_user u ON wo.handler_id = u.id AND IFNULL(u.delete_flag, '0') != '1'
LEFT JOIN jsh_person p ON u.id = p.user_id AND IFNULL(p.delete_flag, '0') != '1' WHERE 1=1
AND wo.status = #{status}
AND wo.work_type = #{type}
AND wo.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND IFNULL(wo.delete_flag, '0') != '1'
ORDER BY CASE wo.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, wo.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE jsh_work_order SET handler_id = #{handlerId}, handler_name = #{handlerName}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'

UPDATE jsh_work_order SET cost = #{cost}, labor_cost = #{laborCost}, material_cost = #{materialCost}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(work_order_no) FROM jsh_work_order WHERE work_order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'
